about.text: A yak's-milk cheese, influenced by Tibetan cuisine. Depending on how it is prepared, Chhurpi can be either hard and chewy, or soft.

sources.text: Boiled buttermilk curd; soft fresh form and hard smoked-dried form; no drying times in source
